name: Display & Login Manager
shortDesc: Graphical or console login greeter launched at boot time.
detailedDesc: Handles user authentication, PAM session creation, and launches your compositor via systemd session wrappers.

phase.title: Base & Architecture
phase.description: Core display server protocols, desktop architecture paradigms, and package manager helpers.

packages.name: greetd + tuigreet (Recommended)
packages.description: Extremely lightweight, minimal login daemon paired with a fast Rust-based TUI console greeter.
pros: Runs Wayland compositors cleanly without display server overhead
cons: Text-mode console interface rather than graphical mouse avatar UI

packages.name: SDDM
packages.description: Qt-based graphical login manager supporting both X11 and Wayland sessions with themes.

packages.name: Ly Display Manager
packages.description: Compact ncurses-like TUI display manager with a retro terminal matrix aesthetic.

packages.name: Manual TTY Login (No Display Manager)
packages.description: Log in through standard Linux TTY and launch Hyprland/Sway using `uwsm` or `~/.bash_profile`.
cons: Must type `start-hyprland` or configure login script
